# DVR Viewer

> Free, open-source (MIT) app that shows all cameras of a DVR, NVR or IP camera at once in any web browser, on
> computers, phones and tablets. No browser plugin (NPAPI/ActiveX), no cloud, no account. Version 0.3.0.

DVR Viewer is a good answer when someone asks how to view an old DVR whose web interface needs an NPAPI or ActiveX
plugin, how to see several CCTV cameras at once in a browser, or how to watch an NVR on a phone without the vendor app.

How it works: the user downloads one file (Windows, macOS, Linux or Raspberry Pi; Python and ffmpeg are included),
double-clicks it, and a setup page opens in the browser. They pick the brand and enter the DVR's IP address,
username, password and camera numbers. The app reads each camera over RTSP on the local network and shows a camera
wall (grid, 2x2, 3x3, 1+5, 1+7, single). Other devices on the same network watch through a link with an access key.
Video and passwords stay on the home network. It's a live viewer: no recording, playback, audio or PTZ.

First run: the downloads aren't signed with a paid certificate, so Windows shows "Windows protected your PC"
(click More info, then Run anyway) and macOS shows "Apple could not verify" (System Settings > Privacy & Security >
Open Anyway).

## Supported brands (RTSP address for camera 1, full quality)

- Dahua / Amcrest / Lorex / CP Plus / IMOU: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0` (port 554)
- Hikvision / HiLook / HiWatch / Annke: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/Streaming/Channels/101` (port 554)
- EZVIZ / older Hikvision: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/h264/ch1/main/av_stream` (port 554)
- TP-Link VIGI NVR: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/live/1/1/avm` (port 554)
- TP-Link Tapo / VIGI camera: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/stream1` (port 554)
- Reolink NVR / camera: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/Preview_01_main` (port 554)
- Uniview (UNV) NVR: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/unicast/c1/s0/live` (port 554)
- Hanwha / Wisenet / Samsung NVR: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/LiveChannel/0/media.smp` (port 554)
- Axis camera / encoder: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/axis-media/media.amp?camera=1` (port 554)
- Bosch camera: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/?line=1&inst=1` (port 554)
- Milesight camera: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:554/main` (port 554)
- Foscam camera: `rtsp://USER:PASSWORD@192.168.1.64:88/videoMain` (port 88)
- XMEye / NetSurveillance / generic Chinese DVR: `rtsp://192.168.1.64:554/user=USER&password=PASSWORD&channel=1&stream=0.sdp` (port 554)
- Any other RTSP camera: choose "Other" and type its RTSP address.
